May 7, 2026 (2026-05-07) (Thursday)

*   [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_7&action=edit&editintro=Portal:Current_events/Edit_instructions)
*   [history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_7&action=history)
*   [watch](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_7&action=watch)

**Armed conflicts and attacks**

*   [Middle Eastern crisis](/wiki/Middle_Eastern_crisis_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)")
    *   [2026 Iran war](/wiki/2026_Iran_war "2026 Iran war")
        *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis "2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis")
            *   The Iranian Ports and Maritime Organization says that [ports](/wiki/List_of_ports_in_Iran "List of ports in Iran") in [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran") are prepared to provide maritime services, technical support, supplies, and medical assistance to ships operating in the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"). [(AA)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-says-ports-ready-to-provide-support-services-to-ships-in-strait-of-hormuz/3929651)

**Politics and elections**

*   [Politics of Solomon Islands](/wiki/Politics_of_Solomon_Islands "Politics of Solomon Islands")
    *   The [Parliament](/wiki/National_Parliament_of_Solomon_Islands "National Parliament of Solomon Islands") of the [Solomon Islands](/wiki/Solomon_Islands "Solomon Islands") debates a [no-confidence motion](/wiki/No-confidence_motion "No-confidence motion") against incumbent [prime minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Solomon_Islands "Prime Minister of Solomon Islands") [Jeremiah Manele](/wiki/Jeremiah_Manele "Jeremiah Manele"). The debate is a culmination of a [political crisis](/wiki/Political_crisis "Political crisis") that started with mass resignations of the cabinet on 16 March, recently escalated by a ruling on 1 May by the [Court of Appeals](/wiki/Judiciary_of_Solomon_Islands "Judiciary of Solomon Islands") ordering the reconvening of Parliament. [(RNZ)](https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/pacific/594356/manele-calls-parliament-for-thursday-to-face-no-confidence-motion)

May 6, 2026 (2026-05-06) (Wednesday)

*   [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_6&action=edit&editintro=Portal:Current_events/Edit_instructions)
*   [history](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_6&action=history)
*   [watch](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_6&action=watch)

**Armed conflicts and attacks**

*   [Middle Eastern crisis](/wiki/Middle_Eastern_crisis_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)")
    *   [2026 Iran war](/wiki/2026_Iran_war "2026 Iran war")
        *   [2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations](/wiki/2025%E2%80%932026_Iran%E2%80%93United_States_negotiations "2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations")
            *   [2026 Iran war ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire "2026 Iran war ceasefire")
                *   [Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/Pakistan_in_the_2026_Iran_war "Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war")
                    *   [Pakistani deputy prime minister](/wiki/Deputy_Prime_Minister_of_Pakistan "Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan") and [foreign minister](/wiki/Minister_for_Foreign_Affairs_\(Pakistan\) "Minister for Foreign Affairs (Pakistan)") [Ishaq Dar](/wiki/Ishaq_Dar "Ishaq Dar") says that [Pakistan](/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") is focusing on making the current [ceasefire](/wiki/Ceasefire "Ceasefire") between [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran") and the [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States") permanent. [(*Pakistan Today*)](https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/05/06/dar-says-pakistan-now-seeks-a-permanent-us-iran-ceasefire)
                *   *[Axios](/wiki/Axios_\(website\) "Axios (website)")* reports that Iran and the U.S. are closing in on a one-page [memorandum](/wiki/Memorandum_of_understanding "Memorandum of understanding") to end the war and set a framework for negotiations regarding [Iran's nuclear program](/wiki/Nuclear_program_of_Iran "Nuclear program of Iran"). [(*Axios*)](https://www.axios.com/2026/05/06/iran-us-deal-one-page-memo) [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-iran-closing-one-page-memo-end-war-axios-reports-2026-05-06/)
        *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis "2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis")
            *   [2026 Iran war regional mobilizations](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_regional_mobilizations "2026 Iran war regional mobilizations")
                *   [France](/wiki/France "France") deploys the [aircraft carrier](/wiki/Aircraft_carrier "Aircraft carrier") [*Charles de Gaulle*](/wiki/French_aircraft_carrier_Charles_de_Gaulle "French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle") and its [strike group](/wiki/Carrier_battle_group "Carrier battle group") to the [Red Sea](/wiki/Red_Sea "Red Sea") ahead of a proposed [British](/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom")–French mission aimed at securing maritime traffic in the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"). [(AP)](https://apnews.com/article/french-carrier-charles-de-gaulle-suez-hormuz-2749dc877f0ac34a0ccd4f0530786009)
            *   [Ships attacked during the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/List_of_ships_attacked_during_the_2026_Iran_war "List of ships attacked during the 2026 Iran war")
                *   French shipping company [CMA CGM](/wiki/CMA_CGM "CMA CGM") says that one of its [container ships](/wiki/Container_ship "Container ship"), *San Antonio*, was attacked yesterday while transiting through the Strait of Hormuz. [(AFP via *Arab News*)](https://arab.news/ghh6c)
            *   The [Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps](/wiki/Islamic_Revolutionary_Guard_Corps "Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps") [Navy](/wiki/IRGC_Navy "IRGC Navy") says that safe passage on the Strait of Hormuz will be assured with new procedures and guidelines following the U.S. pause in [Operation Project Freedom](/wiki/Operation_Project_Freedom "Operation Project Freedom"). [(Al Jazeera)](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/6/french-container-ship-struck-in-latest-escalation-at-strait-of-hormuz)
    *   [2026 Lebanon war](/wiki/2026_Lebanon_war "2026 Lebanon war")
        *   [Israeli attacks on the Lebanese health sector during the Israel-Hezbollah conflict](/wiki/Israeli_attacks_on_the_Lebanese_health_sector_during_the_Israel-Hezbollah_conflict_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Israeli attacks on the Lebanese health sector during the Israel-Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)")
            *   Five people are killed and three [paramedics](/wiki/Health_in_Lebanon "Health in Lebanon") are injured by [Israeli](/wiki/Israel "Israel") [drone strikes](/wiki/Drone_warfare "Drone warfare") and airstrikes across southern [Lebanon](/wiki/Lebanon "Lebanon") despite [the ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Israel%E2%80%93Lebanon_ceasefire "2026 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire"). [(AA)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/israeli-strikes-in-lebanon-kill-5-wound-3-paramedics-damage-school-despite-ceasefire/3928473)
*   [Sudanese civil war](/wiki/Sudanese_civil_war_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Sudanese civil war (2023–present)")
    *   The Sudan Doctors Network says that the death toll from drone strikes launched yesterday by the [Rapid Support Forces](/wiki/Rapid_Support_Forces "Rapid Support Forces") in [Kosti](/wiki/Kosti,_Sudan "Kosti, Sudan"), [White Nile](/wiki/White_Nile_State "White Nile State") has risen to 235 after laboratory doctor Adel Musa al-Tijani was killed in the drone strike. [(*Sudan Tribune*)](https://sudantribune.com/article/313596)
    *   [Ethiopia](/wiki/Ethiopia "Ethiopia") and the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") deny [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan")'s accusations that they were responsible for the [May 4](/wiki/Khartoum_International_Airport#Accidents_and_incidents "Khartoum International Airport") drone attack on [Khartoum International Airport](/wiki/Khartoum_International_Airport "Khartoum International Airport"). [(*Medafrica Times*)](https://medafricatimes.com/45304-ethiopia-rejects-sudans-accusations-calls-for-humanitarian-truce-and-renewed-dialogue.html) [(*Khaleej Times*)](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/uae-rejects-allegations-sudan-airport-attack) [(BBC)](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clype712r3qo)

**Business and economy**

*   [Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/Economic_impact_of_the_2026_Iran_war "Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war")
    *   [Gold prices](/wiki/Gold_as_an_investment "Gold as an investment") rise to more than a one-week high following reports that Iran and the U.S. may be nearing a peace deal to end the war. [(CNBC)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/06/gold-jumps-on-weaker-dollar-middle-east-peace-hopes.html)

**Disasters and accidents**

*   [2026 North Musi Rawas collision](/wiki/2026_North_Musi_Rawas_collision "2026 North Musi Rawas collision")
    *   At least 16 people are killed and four others are injured when a passenger bus crashes into a [tanker truck](/wiki/Tanker_truck "Tanker truck") in [Sumatra](/wiki/Sumatra "Sumatra"), [Indonesia](/wiki/Indonesia "Indonesia"). [(AFP via Al Arabiya)](https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2026/05/06/busoil-tanker-crash-in-sumatra-leaves-16-dead-indonesian-official-)

**Health and environment**

*   [MV *Hondius* hantavirus outbreak](/wiki/MV_Hondius_hantavirus_outbreak "MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak")
    *   Three passengers infected with [hantavirus pulmonary syndrome](/wiki/Hantavirus_pulmonary_syndrome "Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome") from the [Andes virus](/wiki/Andes_virus "Andes virus") are evacuated off the [MV *Hondius*](/wiki/MV_Hondius "MV Hondius") cruise ship while it is stationed off the coast of [Cape Verde](/wiki/Cape_Verde "Cape Verde") to receive treatment in the [Netherlands](/wiki/Netherlands "Netherlands"). At least 145 people remain on board, including two suspected [asymptomatic](/wiki/Asymptomatic "Asymptomatic") cases. [(ABC News)](https://abcnews.com/Health/3-evacuated-off-cruise-ship-suspected-hantavirus-cluster/story?id=132699628) [(NBC News)](https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/hantavirus-cruise-ship-evacuation-new-case-andes-strain-canary-islands-rcna343816)
    *   [Spanish](/wiki/Spain "Spain") [authorities](/wiki/Government_of_Spain "Government of Spain") allow the ship to dock at the [Canary Islands](/wiki/Canary_Islands "Canary Islands") as several passengers are [Spanish citizens](/wiki/Spaniards "Spaniards"). [(BBC News)](https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cy592qeq071t) [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/canarians-worry-arrival-hantavirus-cruise-ship-will-bring-repeat-covid-2026-05-06/)

**International relations**

*   [2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis "2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis"), [China in the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/China_in_the_2026_Iran_war "China in the 2026 Iran war"), [China–Iran relations](/wiki/China%E2%80%93Iran_relations "China–Iran relations")
    *   [Chinese foreign minister](/wiki/Minister_of_Foreign_Affairs_\(China\) "Minister of Foreign Affairs (China)") [Wang Yi](/wiki/Wang_Yi "Wang Yi") and [Iranian foreign minister](/wiki/Minister_of_Foreign_Affairs_\(Iran\) "Minister of Foreign Affairs (Iran)") [Abbas Araghchi](/wiki/Abbas_Araghchi "Abbas Araghchi") meet in [Beijing](/wiki/Beijing "Beijing"), [China](/wiki/China "China"), to discuss reopening the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"), among other related topics, ahead of potential Iran–U.S. talks. [(Al-Monitor)](https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/05/iran-china-discuss-hormuz-reopening-amid-potential-us-iran-talks)

**Politics and elections**

*   [Ivory Coast](/wiki/Ivory_Coast "Ivory Coast") dissolves its [election commission](/wiki/Election_commission "Election commission") following criticism over its management and independence, with [authorities](/wiki/Politics_of_Ivory_Coast "Politics of Ivory Coast") planning to establish a new [electoral](/wiki/Elections_in_Ivory_Coast "Elections in Ivory Coast") administration system. [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ivory-coast-dissolves-electoral-commission-after-criticism-2026-05-06/)
*   [North Korea](/wiki/North_Korea "North Korea") drops mention of [unification](/wiki/Korean_reunification "Korean reunification") with [South Korea](/wiki/South_Korea "South Korea") from [its constitution](/wiki/Constitution_of_North_Korea "Constitution of North Korea"). [(Euronews)](https://www.euronews.com/2026/05/06/north-korea-drops-references-to-unification-with-south-from-constitution-seoul-says)

May 5, 2026 (2026-05-05) (Tuesday)

*   [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_5&action=edit&editintro=Portal:Current_events/Edit_instructions)

**Armed conflicts and attacks**

*   [Middle Eastern crisis](/wiki/Middle_Eastern_crisis_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)")
    *   [2026 Iran war](/wiki/2026_Iran_war "2026 Iran war")
        *   [2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations](/wiki/2025%E2%80%932026_Iran%E2%80%93United_States_negotiations "2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations")
            *   [2026 Iran war ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire "2026 Iran war ceasefire")
                *   [U.S. secretary of state](/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_State "United States Secretary of State") [Marco Rubio](/wiki/Marco_Rubio "Marco Rubio") and [U.S. military](/wiki/United_States_Armed_Forces "United States Armed Forces") leaders, including [U.S. defense secretary](/wiki/United_States_Secretary_of_Defense "United States Secretary of Defense") [Pete Hegseth](/wiki/Pete_Hegseth "Pete Hegseth"), say that the [ceasefire](/wiki/Ceasefire "Ceasefire") is holding despite recent attacks on the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") and [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"). [(Al Jazeera)](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/5/us-iran-ceasefire-holds-despite-hormuz-standoff-pentagon-chief-hegseth) [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-not-looking-fight-with-temporary-operation-protect-ships-iran-pentagon-chief-2026-05-05/)
        *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis "2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis")
            *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_campaign "2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign")
                *   [U.S. president](/wiki/President_of_the_United_States "President of the United States") [Donald Trump](/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") announces a pause in [Operation Project Freedom](/wiki/Operation_Project_Freedom "Operation Project Freedom") aimed at helping ships transit the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"), citing [Pakistan](/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan")'s request to do so and progress in negotiations. [(CNBC)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/05/trump-iran-deal-project-freedom-hormuz-strait.html) [(*Arab News PK*)](https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2642502/pakistan)
        *   Rubio announces that [Operation Epic Fury](/wiki/Operation_Epic_Fury "Operation Epic Fury"), the codename for the initial phase of U.S. military operations in the war with [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran"), has concluded. [(*The Hill*)](https://thehill.com/newsletters/defense-national-security/5865009-rubio-says-operation-epic-fury-is-over/) [(*Time*)](http://time.com/article/2026/05/05/rubio-iran-epic-fury-over-strait-hormuz/)
    *   [Israeli–Palestinian conflict](/wiki/Israeli%E2%80%93Palestinian_conflict "Israeli–Palestinian conflict")
        *   [Gaza war](/wiki/Gaza_war "Gaza war")
            *   The [Israel Defense Forces](/wiki/Israel_Defense_Forces "Israel Defense Forces") confirms that [Hamas](/wiki/Hamas "Hamas") [Nukhba](/wiki/Nukhba_forces "Nukhba forces") commander Anas Muhammad Ibrahim Hamed, who took part in the [October 7, 2023 attacks](/wiki/October_7_attacks "October 7 attacks") including the [Nova music festival massacre](/wiki/Nova_music_festival_massacre "Nova music festival massacre"), was eliminated in a airstrike yesterday in the central [Gaza Strip](/wiki/Gaza_Strip "Gaza Strip"). [(Israel National News)](https://www.israelnationalnews.com/news/426587) [(*Times of Israel*)](https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-gaza-strike-killed-hamas-nukhba-commander-who-participated-in-oct-7-attack/)
*   [Sudanese civil war](/wiki/Sudanese_civil_war_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Sudanese civil war (2023–present)")
    *   [Ethiopia–Sudan relations](/wiki/Ethiopia%E2%80%93Sudan_relations "Ethiopia–Sudan relations")
        *   The [Sudan News Agency](/wiki/Sudan_News_Agency "Sudan News Agency") reports that [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan") has recalled its ambassador to [Ethiopia](/wiki/Ethiopia "Ethiopia"), accusing them of involvement in recent [drone strikes](/wiki/Drone_warfare "Drone warfare") targeting the [airport](/wiki/Khartoum_International_Airport "Khartoum International Airport") in [Khartoum](/wiki/Khartoum "Khartoum"). [(EWN)](https://www.ewn.co.za/2026/05/05/sudan-recalls-ambassador-to-ethiopia-after-airport-attack)
    *   Five people are killed and nine others are injured following a drone strike launched by the [Rapid Support Forces](/wiki/Rapid_Support_Forces "Rapid Support Forces") on two fuel stations in [Kosti](/wiki/Kosti,_Sudan "Kosti, Sudan"), [White Nile](/wiki/White_Nile_State "White Nile State"). [(*Sudan Tribune*)](https://sudantribune.com/article/313569)
*   [Boko Haram insurgency](/wiki/Boko_Haram_insurgency "Boko Haram insurgency")
    *   [Boko Haram](/wiki/Boko_Haram "Boko Haram") militants attack a [Chadian](/wiki/Chad "Chad") [military base](/wiki/Chadian_National_Army "Chadian National Army") on the shores of [Lake Chad](/wiki/Lake_Chad "Lake Chad"), killing 23 security personnel and injuring dozens of others. [(DW)](https://www.dw.com/en/boko-haram-lake-chad-attack/a-77057854)
*   [Russo-Ukrainian war](/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war "Russo-Ukrainian war")
    *   At least 27 people are killed and more than 80 injured in [Russian](/wiki/Russia "Russia") [drone](/wiki/Unmanned_Systems_Forces_\(Russia\) "Unmanned Systems Forces (Russia)") and missile attacks on [Ukraine](/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine"). [(Al Jazeera)](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/5/russian-attack-kills-five-at-ukraines-naftogaz-gas-facility)

**Arts and culture**

*   [Anti-Israeli](/wiki/Anti-Israeli "Anti-Israeli") protests are held outside the [Park East Synagogue](/wiki/Park_East_Synagogue "Park East Synagogue") in [New York City](/wiki/New_York_City "New York City"), [U.S.](/wiki/United_States "United States"), after the [synagogue](/wiki/Synagogue "Synagogue") hosted the Great Israeli Real Estate Event, an [expo](/wiki/Trade_show "Trade show") for land sales in both [Israel](/wiki/Israel "Israel") and the occupied [West Bank](/wiki/Israeli_settlement "Israeli settlement"). [(Al Jazeera)](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/6/pro-palestine-group-protests-outside-israeli-real-estate-event-in-new-york) [(*The New York Times*)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/05/nyregion/nyc-synagogue-protests-israel-real-estate.html)

**Business and economy**

*   As a result of the [motion of no confidence](/wiki/Motion_of_no_confidence "Motion of no confidence") against [Romanian](/wiki/Romania "Romania") [prime minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Romania "Prime Minister of Romania") [Ilie Bolojan](/wiki/Ilie_Bolojan "Ilie Bolojan"), exchange rates between the [Romanian leu](/wiki/Romanian_leu "Romanian leu") and the [euro](/wiki/Euro "Euro") rise to their highest level in history as the leu's value plummets. [(Economica.net in Romanian)](https://www.economica.net/euro-sparge-inca-un-record-o-noua-crestere-in-ziua-motiunii-curs-bnr-5-05-2026_938275.html) [(Digi FM in Romanian)](https://www.digifm.ro/stiri/record-istoric-leul-isi-continua-trendul-descendent-depasind-un-nou-prag-psihologic-euro-a-ajuns-la-521-lei-338991)

**Disasters and accidents**

*   More than twenty people are killed over the past 24 hours in storms, heavy rainfall, and lightning strikes across [Bihar](/wiki/Bihar "Bihar"), [India](/wiki/India "India"). [(*The Hans India*)](https://www.thehansindia.com/news/national/storms-lightning-devastate-bihar-over-20-dead-in-24-hours-1072452)
*   Eight people are killed and 41 others are injured in a fire at a commercial complex in [Andisheh](/wiki/Andisheh "Andisheh"), [Tehran province](/wiki/Tehran_province "Tehran province"), [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran"). [(AA)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/8-killed-41-injured-in-fire-at-commercial-complex-near-tehran/3928395)

**Health and environment**

*   [COVID-19 drug development](/wiki/COVID-19_drug_development "COVID-19 drug development")
    *   [German](/wiki/Germany "Germany") [biotechnology](/wiki/Biotechnology "Biotechnology") company [BioNTech](/wiki/BioNTech "BioNTech") announces it will halt production of its [COVID-19 vaccine](/wiki/Pfizer%E2%80%93BioNTech_COVID-19_vaccine "Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine") due to [drastic restructuring plans](/wiki/German_economic_crisis_\(2022%E2%80%93present\) "German economic crisis (2022–present)"), leaving sole production of the [vaccine](/wiki/COVID-19_vaccine "COVID-19 vaccine") to its partner [Pfizer](/wiki/Pfizer "Pfizer"). [(DW)](https://www.dw.com/en/germany-biontech-shutting-down-covid-vaccine-production-entirely-1860-jobs-at-risk/a-77055320) [(*Wall Street Journal*)](https://www.wsj.com/business/earnings/biontech-to-close-sites-cut-quarter-of-workforce-in-savings-push-56201ed1)

**Law and crime**

*   [Mass shootings in the United States](/wiki/Mass_shootings_in_the_United_States "Mass shootings in the United States")
    *   [2026 Carrollton Koreatown shootings](/wiki/2026_Carrollton_Koreatown_shootings "2026 Carrollton Koreatown shootings")
        *   Two people are killed and three others injured in a [mass shooting](/wiki/Mass_shooting "Mass shooting") at a Korean supermarket in [Carrollton](/wiki/Carrollton,_Texas "Carrollton, Texas"), [Texas](/wiki/Texas "Texas"), U.S., after a 69-year-old man opened fire on his coworkers at a business meeting. The suspect is taken into custody. [(NBC News)](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/2-dead-3-injured-shooting-korean-supermarket-dallas-rcna343725)
*   Two people are killed and seven others are injured in a [school shooting](/wiki/School_shooting "School shooting") in [Rio Branco](/wiki/Rio_Branco,_Acre "Rio Branco, Acre"), [Acre](/wiki/Acre_\(state\) "Acre (state)"), [Brazil](/wiki/Brazil "Brazil"). A 13-year-old suspect is taken into custody. [(Xinhua)](https://english.news.cn/20260506/7a3e4d29f27c4e70a6d431c7d070fb25/c.html) [(Central Brasileira de Notícias in Portuguese)](https://cbn.globo.com/brasil/noticia/2026/05/05/ataque-a-tiros-em-escola-de-rio-branco-deixa-duas-funcionarias-mortas.ghtml)
*   In [Pasig](/wiki/Pasig "Pasig"), [Philippines](/wiki/Philippines "Philippines"), the [National Bureau of Investigation](/wiki/National_Bureau_of_Investigation_\(Philippines\) "National Bureau of Investigation (Philippines)") arrests the founder of an online news site and four other people, in an [entrapment](/wiki/Entrapment "Entrapment") operation for an alleged [extortion](/wiki/Extortion "Extortion") attempt on former [House speaker](/wiki/Speaker_of_the_House_of_Representatives_of_the_Philippines "Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Philippines") [Martin Romualdez](/wiki/Martin_Romualdez "Martin Romualdez"). [(*Gulf News*)](https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/philippines-social-media-founder-franco-mabanta-arrested-following-alleged-350-million-romualdez-extortion-plot-1.500530705) [(PNA)](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1274433)

**Politics and elections**

*   [Politics of Romania](/wiki/Politics_of_Romania "Politics of Romania")
    *   The [Parliament of Romania](/wiki/Parliament_of_Romania "Parliament of Romania") votes 281–4 to pass a [motion of no confidence](/wiki/Motion_of_no_confidence "Motion of no confidence"), called by the [Social Democratic Party](/wiki/Social_Democratic_Party_\(Romania\) "Social Democratic Party (Romania)") and [Alliance for the Union of Romanians](/wiki/Alliance_for_the_Union_of_Romanians "Alliance for the Union of Romanians"), against prime minister [Ilie Bolojan](/wiki/Ilie_Bolojan "Ilie Bolojan"). [(AP)](https://apnews.com/article/romania-government-no-confidence-motion-european-union-cae251a0ef62c9941d9355c0b2c927ea) [(AFP via France 24)](https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20260505-romania-s-pro-eu-coalition-government-collapses-after-prime-minister-loses-no-confidence-vote)
    *   [President](/wiki/President_of_Romania "President of Romania") [Nicușor Dan](/wiki/Nicu%C8%99or_Dan "Nicușor Dan") refuses the possibility of holding [snap elections](/wiki/Snap_election "Snap election"), saying that a new government will be formed comprising a coalition of pro-Western parties. [(Radio Romania in Romanian)](https://www.romania-actualitati.ro/stiri/romania/nicusor-dan-a-exclus-scenariul-alegerilor-anticipate-id227942.html)
*   [Louise Arbour](/wiki/Louise_Arbour "Louise Arbour") is announced by [prime minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Canada "Prime Minister of Canada") [Mark Carney](/wiki/Mark_Carney "Mark Carney") as the next [governor general of Canada](/wiki/Governor_general_of_Canada "Governor general of Canada"). [(*The Guardian*)](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/may/05/carney-appoints-louise-arbor-canada-governor-general)
*   The [Ugandan](/wiki/Uganda "Uganda") [parliament](/wiki/Parliament_of_Uganda "Parliament of Uganda") passes the Protection of Sovereignty Bill, which restricts foreign involvement in policymaking without [government](/wiki/Politics_of_Uganda "Politics of Uganda") approval and imposes penalties of up to 10 years' imprisonment for violations. [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/ugandan-lawmakers-pass-scaled-back-sovereignty-law-after-central-bank-warning-2026-05-06/)

May 4, 2026 (2026-05-04) (Monday)

*   [edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal:Current_events/2026_May_4&action=edit&editintro=Portal:Current_events/Edit_instructions)

**Armed conflicts and attacks**

*   [2026 Iran war](/wiki/2026_Iran_war "2026 Iran war")
    *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_crisis "2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis")
        *   [2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign](/wiki/2026_Strait_of_Hormuz_campaign "2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign")
            *   [Operation Project Freedom](/wiki/Operation_Project_Freedom "Operation Project Freedom")
                *   The [U.S. Central Command](/wiki/United_States_Central_Command "United States Central Command") says that two [US-flagged](/wiki/United_States_Merchant_Marine "United States Merchant Marine") [merchant vessels](/wiki/Merchant_ship "Merchant ship") have passed through the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz"), the first vessels to cross the waterway since the start of Project Freedom. Additionally, CENTCOM also says that [U.S. Navy](/wiki/United_States_Navy "United States Navy") [guided-missile destroyers](/wiki/Guided-missile_destroyer "Guided-missile destroyer") transited through the [waterway](/wiki/Waterway "Waterway"). [(*The Hill*)](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5862288-us-cargo-ships-strait-hormuz/) [(Axios)](https://www.axios.com/2026/05/04/strait-hormuz-us-merchant-ships-cross)
            *   Iranian media report that the [Iranian navy](/wiki/Islamic_Republic_of_Iran_Navy "Islamic Republic of Iran Navy") struck a [U.S. Navy](/wiki/U.S._Navy "U.S. Navy") warship with two missiles, after it ignored warnings off the coast of [Jask](/wiki/Jask "Jask"). [United States Central Command](/wiki/United_States_Central_Command "United States Central Command") denies the claim that a ship was hit. [(Al Jazeera)](https://aje.news/t7e6pf?update=4543540) [(CNBC)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/04/iran-war-trump-strait-of-hormuz.html)
            *   A fire and explosion is reported on an anchored [HMM](/wiki/HMM_\(company\) "HMM (company)") vessel in the [Strait of Hormuz](/wiki/Strait_of_Hormuz "Strait of Hormuz") near the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates"). No casualties were reported. [(Yonhap)](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20260504010952315?section=national/diplomacy)
            *   A vessel belonging to [Abu Dhabi National Oil Company](/wiki/Abu_Dhabi_National_Oil_Company "Abu Dhabi National Oil Company") is attacked by two drones in the Strait of Hormuz. No injuries were reported. [(Gulf News)](https://gulfnews.com/uae/iranian-drones-attack-adnoc-tanker-in-strait-of-hormuz-1.500528456)
        *   [2026 United States naval blockade of Iran](/wiki/2026_United_States_naval_blockade_of_Iran "2026 United States naval blockade of Iran")
            *   The [Pakistani foreign ministry](/wiki/Ministry_of_Foreign_Affairs_\(Pakistan\) "Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Pakistan)") says that the [U.S.](/wiki/United_States "United States") has evacuated 22 crew members on the *[Touska](/wiki/Touska "Touska")* and will hand them to Iranian authorities. [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-evacuates-22-crew-members-seized-iranian-ship-pakistan-2026-05-04/)
            *   The [IRNA](/wiki/Islamic_Republic_News_Agency "Islamic Republic News Agency") confirms that the 22 sailors returned home to Iran at a border terminal in [Sistan-Baluchistan](/wiki/Sistan_and_Baluchestan_province "Sistan and Baluchestan province"). [(*Pakistan Today*)](https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/05/04/iranian-sailors-return-home-via-pakistan-after-us-release-in-confidence-building-move)
    *   [2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations](/wiki/2025%E2%80%932026_Iran%E2%80%93United_States_negotiations "2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations"), [Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/Pakistan_in_the_2026_Iran_war "Pakistan in the 2026 Iran war")
        *   [2026 Iran war ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire "2026 Iran war ceasefire")
            *   [Iranian foreign minister](/wiki/Ministry_of_Foreign_Affairs_\(Iran\) "Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)") [Abbas Araghchi](/wiki/Abbas_Araghchi "Abbas Araghchi") and [Pakistani foreign minister](/wiki/Minister_for_Foreign_Affairs_\(Pakistan\) "Minister for Foreign Affairs (Pakistan)") [Ishaq Dar](/wiki/Ishaq_Dar "Ishaq Dar") hold a phone call to discuss [Pakistan](/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan")'s efforts to revive [ceasefire](/wiki/Ceasefire "Ceasefire") talks between [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran") and the [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States") aimed at ending the war. [(AA)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/top-pakistani-iranian-diplomats-discuss-efforts-to-revive-stalled-talks-with-us/3926042) [(Al Arabiya)](https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/middle-east/2026/05/04/pakistan-foreign-minister-discusses-regional-situation-on-call-with-iran-s-araghchi)
    *   [2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries](/wiki/2026_Iranian_strikes_on_Arab_countries "2026 Iranian strikes on Arab countries")
        *   [2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates](/wiki/2026_Iranian_strikes_on_the_United_Arab_Emirates "2026 Iranian strikes on the United Arab Emirates")
            *   The [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") reports that it has intercepted three [missiles from Iran](/wiki/Ballistic_missile_program_of_Iran "Ballistic missile program of Iran"), with the 4th one falling into the sea. This is the first report of missile interceptions since [the ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire "2026 Iran war ceasefire") began on April 7. [(*Khaleej Times*)](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/emergencies/uae-detects-4-cruise-missiles-may-4?amp=1)
            *   A strike on an [energy facility](/wiki/Energy_in_the_United_Arab_Emirates "Energy in the United Arab Emirates") in the [Fujairah emirate](/wiki/Emirate_of_Fujairah "Emirate of Fujairah") injures three [Indian nationals](/wiki/Indians_in_the_United_Arab_Emirates "Indians in the United Arab Emirates"). [(AFP via LBCI)](https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/middleeastnews/929966/three-injured-in-strike-targeting-energy-installation-in-uaes-fujairah/en)
*   [Sudanese civil war](/wiki/Sudanese_civil_war_\(2023%E2%80%93present\) "Sudanese civil war (2023–present)")
    *   [Rapid Support Forces](/wiki/Rapid_Support_Forces "Rapid Support Forces") launch drone attacks at several targets in [Khartoum](/wiki/Khartoum "Khartoum"), [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan"), including the [Khartoum International Airport](/wiki/Khartoum_International_Airport "Khartoum International Airport") in [Khartoum](/wiki/Khartoum "Khartoum"), [Sudan](/wiki/Sudan "Sudan"). Drone strikes are also reported at the Signal Corps in [Khartoum Bahri](/wiki/Khartoum_North "Khartoum North") and Al-Markhiyat camp in northern [Omdurman](/wiki/Omdurman "Omdurman"). [(Sudan Tribune)](https://sudantribune.com/article/313495)
    *   The [Sudan Army](/wiki/Sudanese_Armed_Forces "Sudanese Armed Forces")'s air defenses intercept drone strikes at the airport. [(Yaffaps)](https://yaffaps.com/en/page-99945.html)

**Business and economy**

*   [Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/Economic_impact_of_the_2026_Iran_war "Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war")
    *   The [Dubai International Airport](/wiki/Dubai_International_Airport "Dubai International Airport") in [Dubai](/wiki/Dubai "Dubai"), United Arab Emirates, reports a 66% drop in passenger traffic in [March 2026](/wiki/2026#March "2026") amidst a disruption of air traffic in the [Middle East](/wiki/Middle_East "Middle East") due to the Iran war. [(Bloomberg)](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-04/dubai-airport-passenger-traffic-drops-66-in-march-on-iran-war)

**Disasters and accidents**

*   [2026 Liuyang fireworks factory explosion](/wiki/2026_Liuyang_fireworks_factory_explosion "2026 Liuyang fireworks factory explosion")
    *   At least 26 people are killed in an explosion at a fireworks factory in [Liuyang](/wiki/Liuyang "Liuyang"), [Hunan](/wiki/Hunan "Hunan"), [China](/wiki/China "China"). [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/blast-fireworks-factory-chinas-hunan-province-kills-21-injures-61-cctv-2026-05-05/)
*   Eight people are killed in a road accident in [Dandong](/wiki/Dandong "Dandong"), [Liaoning](/wiki/Liaoning "Liaoning"), [China](/wiki/China "China"). [(Xinhua)](https://english.news.cn/20260504/5733878210cb473d8c98b09d04ab8ace/c.html)
*   Seven people are killed and 13 others critically injured after a bus collided head-on with a trailer in [Northern Uganda](/wiki/Northern_Uganda "Northern Uganda"). [(Xinhua)](https://english.news.cn/africa/20260504/193dc58d27b047c6816cba3c3369d717/c.html)

**Armed conflicts and attacks**

*   [2026 Iran war](/wiki/2026_Iran_war "2026 Iran war")
    *   [2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations](/wiki/2025%E2%80%932026_Iran%E2%80%93United_States_negotiations "2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations")
        *   [2026 Iran war ceasefire](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_ceasefire "2026 Iran war ceasefire")
            *   State media [IRNA](/wiki/Islamic_Republic_News_Agency "Islamic Republic News Agency") reports that [Iran](/wiki/Iran "Iran") has sent a proposal for negotiations with the [United States](/wiki/United_States "United States") to mediators from [Pakistan](/wiki/Pakistan "Pakistan") in an effort to [end](/wiki/Ceasefire "Ceasefire") the Iran war. [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/uae-says-iran-cannot-be-trusted-over-hormuz-peace-efforts-an-impasse-2026-05-01/)
    *   [2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East](/wiki/2026_United_States_military_buildup_in_the_Middle_East "2026 United States military buildup in the Middle East")
        *   [USS *Gerald R. Ford*](/wiki/USS_Gerald_R._Ford "USS Gerald R. Ford") officially exits the [Middle East](/wiki/Middle_East "Middle East") after taking part in operations in Iran during the war, leaving only the [USS *Abraham Lincoln*](/wiki/USS_Abraham_Lincoln_\(CVN-72\) "USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72)") and [USS *George H. W. Bush*](/wiki/USS_George_H._W._Bush "USS George H. W. Bush") in the region.     *   [U.S. president](/wiki/President_of_the_United_States "President of the United States") [Donald Trump](/wiki/Donald_Trump "Donald Trump") notifies [Congress](/wiki/United_States_Congress "United States Congress") that it is planning to close the [Civil-Military Coordination Center](/wiki/Civil-Military_Coordination_Center "Civil-Military Coordination Center"). The [Board of Peace](/wiki/Board_of_Peace "Board of Peace") denies such reports. [(*The Times of Israel*)](https://www.timesofisrael.com/board-of-peace-denies-plans-to-shut-down-ceasefire-coordination-hq-in-israels-south/)
*   [Mali War](/wiki/Mali_War "Mali War")
    *   [2026 Mali attacks](/wiki/2026_Mali_attacks "2026 Mali attacks")
        *   [Jihadist](/wiki/Jihadism "Jihadism") group [Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin](/wiki/Jama%27at_Nusrat_al-Islam_wal-Muslimin "Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin") takes over a base outside of [Tessalit](/wiki/Tessalit "Tessalit"), [Kidal Region](/wiki/Kidal_Region "Kidal Region"), [Mali](/wiki/Mali "Mali"), after it is abandoned by [Malian troops](/wiki/Malian_Armed_Forces "Malian Armed Forces") and [Russia](/wiki/Russia "Russia")'s [Africa Corps](/wiki/Africa_Corps_\(Russia\) "Africa Corps (Russia)"). [(AFP via *Barron's*)](https://www.barrons.com/news/rebels-take-key-military-camp-in-mali-s-north-f5fdc5a1)
    *   [Al Qaeda](/wiki/Al_Qaeda "Al Qaeda")\-linked insurgents call for [Malians](/wiki/Malians "Malians") to rise up against the [Mali](/wiki/Mali "Mali") [military junta](/wiki/Military_junta "Military junta") and transition to [Sharia law](/wiki/Sharia "Sharia"). [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-qaeda-linked-insurgents-call-malians-rise-up-establish-sharia-law-2026-05-01/)
*   [Myanmar civil war](/wiki/Myanmar_civil_war_\(2021%E2%80%93present\) "Myanmar civil war (2021–present)")
    *   Six civilians are killed and nine more were injured after the military [junta](/wiki/Tatmadaw "Tatmadaw") bombed a village in [Falam Township](/wiki/Falam_Township "Falam Township"), [Chin State](/wiki/Chin_State "Chin State"). [(BNI) in Burmese](https://www.bnionline.net/mm/news-114751)
*   [Terrorism in the United Kingdom](/wiki/Terrorism_in_the_United_Kingdom "Terrorism in the United Kingdom"), [2026 London antisemitic attacks](/wiki/2026_London_antisemitic_attacks "2026 London antisemitic attacks")
    *   [2026 Golders Green attack](/wiki/2026_Golders_Green_attack "2026 Golders Green attack"), [Antisemitism during the 2026 Iran war](/wiki/Antisemitism_during_the_2026_Iran_war "Antisemitism during the 2026 Iran war")
        *   A 45-year-old man is charged with three counts of attempted [murder](/wiki/Murder_in_English_law "Murder in English law") after attacking three people in [London](/wiki/London "London"), [England](/wiki/England "England"), on Wednesday. [(BBC News)](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3r2lr434wlo)
*   [Dissident Irish republican campaign](/wiki/Dissident_Irish_republican_campaign "Dissident Irish republican campaign")
    *   A 66-year-old man is charged with several offences, including [terrorism](/wiki/Terrorism "Terrorism"), following a [car bombing](/wiki/Car_bomb "Car bomb") outside of a police station in [Dunmurry](/wiki/Dunmurry "Dunmurry"), [Belfast](/wiki/Belfast "Belfast"), [Northern Ireland](/wiki/Northern_Ireland "Northern Ireland"). [(Sky News)](https://news.sky.com/story/man-66-charged-after-car-bomb-attack-outside-police-station-in-northern-ireland-13538984)
*   [World War II bomb disposal in Europe](/wiki/World_War_II_bomb_disposal_in_Europe "World War II bomb disposal in Europe")
    *   A [World War II](/wiki/World_War_II "World War II")\-era [German](/wiki/Nazi_Germany "Nazi Germany") [SC250 bomb](/wiki/SC250_bomb "SC250 bomb") is safely [detonated](/wiki/Controlled_explosion "Controlled explosion") by the [British Army](/wiki/British_Army "British Army") in [Plymouth](/wiki/Plymouth "Plymouth"), [England](/wiki/England "England"), following its discovery on a building site that prompted the [emergency evacuation](/wiki/Emergency_evacuation "Emergency evacuation") of 1,000 homes. [(BBC News)](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cewp151w9jzt)

**Business and economy**

*   [Crisis in Venezuela](/wiki/Crisis_in_Venezuela "Crisis in Venezuela")
    *   [Venezuelan](/wiki/Venezuela "Venezuela") acting [president](/wiki/President_of_Venezuela "President of Venezuela") [Delcy Rodríguez](/wiki/Delcy_Rodr%C3%ADguez "Delcy Rodríguez") raises the [minimum income](/wiki/Minimum_income "Minimum income") package by 26.3% to [US$](/wiki/United_States_dollar "United States dollar")240 and increases [pensions](/wiki/Pension "Pension") to $70, as [the government](/wiki/Government_of_Venezuela "Government of Venezuela") responds to protests over low wages amid high [inflation](/wiki/Inflation "Inflation"). [(AFP via France 24)](https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260430-venezuela-leader-hikes-minimum-wage-package-by-26)

**Disasters and accidents**

*   Fourteen [Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps](/wiki/Islamic_Revolutionary_Guard_Corps "Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps") members are killed and two others are injured when an unexploded ordnance detonated in [Zanjan province](/wiki/Zanjan_province "Zanjan province"), Iran. *   Eleven people are killed after a passenger bus carrying medical staff and patients collided head-on with a truck near [Otjiwarongo](/wiki/Otjiwarongo "Otjiwarongo"), [Namibia](/wiki/Namibia "Namibia"). [(Xinhua)](https://english.news.cn/africa/20260501/2678d80da5b449679a6b135949f2730b/c.html)
*   At least eleven people are killed and 31 others are injured when a passenger bus veers off a highway and overturns near [Amatlán de Cañas](/wiki/Amatl%C3%A1n_de_Ca%C3%B1as "Amatlán de Cañas"), [Nayarit](/wiki/Nayarit "Nayarit"), [Mexico](/wiki/Mexico "Mexico"). [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-11-dead-western-mexico-after-bus-careens-off-highway-2026-05-01/)
*   Nine people are killed, including two children, when a cruise boat [capsizes](/wiki/Capsizing "Capsizing") in the [Bargi Dam](/wiki/Bargi_Dam "Bargi Dam") in [Jabalpur](/wiki/Jabalpur "Jabalpur"), [Madhya Pradesh](/wiki/Madhya_Pradesh "Madhya Pradesh"), [India](/wiki/India "India"). *   Three people are killed and 30 others are injured after a minibus rolled over in [Balıkesir](/wiki/Bal%C4%B1kesir "Balıkesir"), [Turkey](/wiki/Turkey "Turkey"). [(AA in Turkish)](https://aa.com.tr/tr/gundem/balikesirde-devrilen-yolcu-otobusundeki-3-kisi-oldu-30-kisi-yaralandi/3923799)
*   Three people are killed and two others are injured when a bridge collapses in [Jammu](/wiki/Jammu "Jammu"), [Jammu and Kashmir](/wiki/Jammu_and_Kashmir_\(union_territory\) "Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)"), India. [(*India Today*)](https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/jammu-bridge-collapse-three-dead-two-injured-engineers-suspended-probe-2904737-2026-05-02)
*   A [gold mine](/wiki/Gold_mining "Gold mining") collapse in a remote area of the [Shahri Buzurg District](/wiki/Shahri_Buzurg_District "Shahri Buzurg District") of [Badakhshan](/wiki/Badakhshan_Province "Badakhshan Province") [province](/wiki/Provinces_of_Afghanistan "Provinces of Afghanistan"), [Afghanistan](/wiki/Afghanistan "Afghanistan"), kills five people including two children. [(KabulNow)](https://kabulnow.com/2026/05/gold-mine-collapse-kills-five-injures-eight-in-afghanistans-badakhshan/)

**International relations**

*   [Russia–European Union relations](/wiki/Russia%E2%80%93European_Union_relations "Russia–European Union relations"), [Legality of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine](/wiki/Legality_of_the_2022_Russian_invasion_of_Ukraine "Legality of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine")
    *   The [European Parliament](/wiki/European_Parliament "European Parliament") adopts a resolution supporting the establishment of a [special tribunal](/wiki/Special_Tribunal_for_the_Crime_of_Aggression_against_Ukraine "Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine") to prosecute [Russian](/wiki/Russia "Russia") leaders for [crimes](/wiki/Atrocity_crimes_during_the_Russo-Ukrainian_war "Atrocity crimes during the Russo-Ukrainian war") related to [the war](/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war_\(2022%E2%80%93present\) "Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)") in [Ukraine](/wiki/Ukraine "Ukraine") and calls for [sanctions](/wiki/International_sanctions_during_the_Russo-Ukrainian_war "International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian war") to remain until [a peace agreement](/wiki/Peace_negotiations_in_the_Russo-Ukrainian_war_\(2022%E2%80%93present\) "Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)") is fully implemented. [(Euromaidan Press)](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/04/30/european-parliament-backs-establishment-of-a-special-tribunal-for-russia/)

**Law and crime**

*   [2026 May Day protests](/wiki/2026_May_Day_protests "2026 May Day protests")
    *   [2025–2026 Turkish protests](/wiki/2025%E2%80%932026_Turkish_protests "2025–2026 Turkish protests")
        *   [Turkish police](/wiki/General_Directorate_of_Security_\(Turkey\) "General Directorate of Security (Turkey)") arrest at least 57 people and use [tear gas](/wiki/Tear_gas "Tear gas") to disperse [May Day](/wiki/International_Workers%27_Day "International Workers' Day") demonstrators in [Istanbul](/wiki/Istanbul "Istanbul"), where authorities block access to [Taksim Square](/wiki/Taksim_Square "Taksim Square") to prevent marches. [(AFP via *FMT*)](https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/05/01/turkish-cops-fire-tear-gas-arrest-dozens-at-may-day-rallies)
    *   Protests and demonstrations are held worldwide on [May Day](/wiki/International_Workers%27_Day "International Workers' Day") to call for peace, higher wages and better working conditions. Additionally, protests are held [against the Iran war](/wiki/Protests_against_the_2026_Iran_war "Protests against the 2026 Iran war") and the [global energy and fuel crisis](/wiki/2026_Iran_war_fuel_crisis "2026 Iran war fuel crisis") caused by the war. [(PBS)](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/economy/what-to-know-about-may-day-as-workers-face-rising-costs-due-to-iran-war) [(Common Dreams)](https://www.commondreams.org/news/may-day-protests-2026)
    *   A [Labour Day](/wiki/Labour_Day "Labour Day") rally organized by [Kilusang Mayo Uno](/wiki/Kilusang_Mayo_Uno "Kilusang Mayo Uno") is held in [Manila](/wiki/Manila "Manila"), [Philippines](/wiki/Philippines "Philippines"). During the rally, protesters attempt to storm the [U.S. embassy](/wiki/Embassy_of_the_United_States,_Manila "Embassy of the United States, Manila") to [demand](/wiki/Protests_against_the_2026_Iran_war "Protests against the 2026 Iran war") an end to the Iran war and clash with police, injuring seven officers. [(*Philippine Daily Inquirer*)](https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2221850/police-protesters-clash-over-cops-hurt-at-labor-day-rally-effigy-burningq) [(Xinhua)](https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20260501/f5c1c4a19a2f42a39085ec7cc1dc09a5/c.html)
    *   May Day protests are held across the [U.S.](/wiki/United_States "United States"), including an economic blackout as part of 3,500 "May Day Strong" events across the country. Additionally, demonstrations are held outside institutions such as the [New York Stock Exchange](/wiki/New_York_Stock_Exchange "New York Stock Exchange"). [(*Time*)](https://time.com/article/2026/05/01/may-day-international-workers-day-protests-rallies-marches-us/) [(*The Guardian*)](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/may/01/may-day-strong-economic-protests)
*   [Connections of Jeffrey Epstein](/wiki/Connections_of_Jeffrey_Epstein "Connections of Jeffrey Epstein")
    *   [Leon Botstein](/wiki/Leon_Botstein "Leon Botstein"), president of [Bard College](/wiki/Bard_College "Bard College") in [New York](/wiki/New_York_\(state\) "New York (state)"), U.S., announces his retirement over his [ties](/wiki/Epstein_files "Epstein files") to the [late](/wiki/Death_of_Jeffrey_Epstein "Death of Jeffrey Epstein") financier and [sex offender](/wiki/Sex_offender "Sex offender") [Jeffrey Epstein](/wiki/Jeffrey_Epstein "Jeffrey Epstein"). [(AP)](https://apnews.com/article/bard-college-jeffery-epstein-db00b913eb1c231e135179b52e99ee95) [(*The Independent*)](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/new-york-president-jeffrey-epstein-executive-committee-god-b2969293.html)
*   [Killing of Kumanjayi Little Baby](/wiki/Killing_of_Kumanjayi_Little_Baby "Killing of Kumanjayi Little Baby")
    *   Members of [Alice Springs](/wiki/Alice_Springs "Alice Springs")' [Aboriginal](/wiki/Aboriginal_Australians "Aboriginal Australians") community in [Northern Territory](/wiki/Northern_Territory "Northern Territory"), [Australia](/wiki/Australia "Australia"), clash with [police](/wiki/Northern_Territory_Police_Force "Northern Territory Police Force") outside a hospital where a man charged with the [murder](/wiki/Murder_in_Australian_law "Murder in Australian law") of a five-year-old [Warlpiri](/wiki/Warlpiri_people "Warlpiri people") girl is being treated, demanding the suspect be punished under traditional law. This follows a five-day search for the missing girl with large community participation before she was confirmed dead. [(*The Guardian*)](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/apr/30/jefferson-lewis-arrested-over-death-of-kumanjayi-little-baby-in-northern-territory)
*   [Mexican drug war](/wiki/Mexican_drug_war "Mexican drug war")
    *   [Rubén Rocha Moya](/wiki/Rub%C3%A9n_Rocha_Moya "Rubén Rocha Moya") announces he will temporarily step down as [governor](/wiki/Governor_of_Sinaloa "Governor of Sinaloa") of [Sinaloa](/wiki/Sinaloa "Sinaloa"), Mexico, after the U.S. files charges alleging links to the [Sinaloa Cartel](/wiki/Sinaloa_Cartel "Sinaloa Cartel"). [(Reuters)](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-governor-ruben-rocha-steps-down-nyt-reports-2026-05-02/)
*   The [Renters' Rights Act 2025](/wiki/Renters%27_Rights_Act_2025 "Renters' Rights Act 2025") formally enters force in [England](/wiki/England "England"), banning [Section 21 notices](/wiki/Section_21_notice "Section 21 notice") (no-fault [evictions](/wiki/Eviction "Eviction")), limiting [rent](/wiki/Renting "Renting") increases to once per year, giving tenants the legal right to keep pets, abolishing [assured shorthold tenancies](/wiki/Assured_shorthold_tenancy "Assured shorthold tenancy"), and making it illegal to discriminate against tenants based on them having children, or receiving [benefits](/wiki/Welfare_state_in_the_United_Kingdom "Welfare state in the United Kingdom"). [(*The Independent*)](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/renters-rights-act-2026-no-fault-evictions-b2968188.html)
*   One person is killed and 11 others are injured in a [vehicle-ramming attack](/wiki/Vehicle-ramming_attack "Vehicle-ramming attack") in [Chengdu](/wiki/Chengdu "Chengdu"), [Sichuan](/wiki/Sichuan "Sichuan"), [China](/wiki/China "China"). The suspect is arrested. [(*The Standard*)](https://www.thestandard.com.hk/china/article/330903/One-dead-11-injured-in-horrific-hit-and-run-rampage-in-Chengdu)

**Politics and elections**

*   [2026 Antiguan general election](/wiki/2026_Antiguan_general_election "2026 Antiguan general election")
    *   Official results from yesterday's election indicated that the [ABLP](/wiki/Antigua_and_Barbuda_Labour_Party "Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party") led by [Antiguan](/wiki/Antigua_and_Barbuda "Antigua and Barbuda") [prime minister](/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Antigua_and_Barbuda "Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda") [Gaston Browne](/wiki/Gaston_Browne "Gaston Browne") won 15 of 17 seats, while [UPP](/wiki/United_Progressive_Party "United Progressive Party") leader [Jamale Pringle](/wiki/Jamale_Pringle "Jamale Pringle") and [BPM](/wiki/Barbuda_People%27s_Movement "Barbuda People's Movement") leader [Trevor Walker](/wiki/Trevor_Walker "Trevor Walker") each retained their own seats. Browne is sworn in for a fourth term in office. [(*Antigua.news*)](https://antigua.news/2026/05/01/pm-browne-and-ag-benjamin-officially-sworn-in-following-election-victory/) [(AP)](https://apnews.com/article/antigua-barbuda-gaston-browne-reelection-d447535a8fdd8eeb9969449812a88dfa)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Ethernet with speeds above 100 Gbit/s

**Terabit Ethernet** (**TbE**) is [Ethernet](/wiki/Ethernet "Ethernet") with speeds above [100 Gigabit Ethernet](/wiki/100_Gigabit_Ethernet "100 Gigabit Ethernet"). The **400 Gigabit Ethernet** (**400G**, **400GbE**) and **200 Gigabit Ethernet** (**200G**, **200GbE**)[\[1\]](#cite_note-NGOATH-1) standard developed by the [IEEE](/wiki/IEEE "IEEE") P802.3bs Task Force using broadly similar technology to 100 Gigabit Ethernet[\[2\]](#cite_note-register2012-2)[\[3\]](#cite_note-3) was approved on December 6, 2017.[\[4\]](#cite_note-approval-4)[\[5\]](#cite_note-LHUFF2016-5) On February 16, 2024 the **800 Gigabit Ethernet (800G, 800GbE**) standard developed by the IEEE P802.3df Task Force was approved.[\[6\]](#cite_note-6)

The [Optical Internetworking Forum](/wiki/Optical_Internetworking_Forum "Optical Internetworking Forum") (OIF) has already announced five new projects at 112 [Gbit/s](/wiki/Gbit/s "Gbit/s") which would also make 4th generation (single-lane) 100 GbE links possible.[\[7\]](#cite_note-112G-7) The [IEEE](/wiki/IEEE "IEEE") P802.3df Task Force started work in January 2022 to standardize 800 Gbit/s and 1.6 Tbit/s Ethernet. [\[8\]](#cite_note-8) In November 2022 the IEEE 802.3df project objectives were split in two, with 1.6T and 200G/lane work being moved to the new IEEE 802.3dj project. The timeline for the 802.3dj project indicates completion in July 2026. [\[9\]](#cite_note-9)

## History

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")\]

[Facebook](/wiki/Facebook "Facebook") and [Google](/wiki/Google "Google"), among other companies, have expressed a need for TbE.[\[10\]](#cite_note-10) While a speed of 400 Gbit/s is achievable with existing technology, 1 Tbit/s (1000 Gbit/s) would require different technology.[\[2\]](#cite_note-register2012-2)[\[11\]](#cite_note-11) Accordingly, at the IEEE Industry Connections Higher Speed Ethernet Consensus group meeting in September 2012, 400 GbE was chosen as the next generation goal.[\[2\]](#cite_note-register2012-2) Additional 200 GbE objectives were added in January 2016.

The [University of California, Santa Barbara](/wiki/University_of_California,_Santa_Barbara "University of California, Santa Barbara") (UCSB) attracted help from [Agilent Technologies](/wiki/Agilent_Technologies "Agilent Technologies"), Google, [Intel](/wiki/Intel "Intel"), [Rockwell Collins](/wiki/Rockwell_Collins "Rockwell Collins"), and [Verizon Communications](/wiki/Verizon_Communications "Verizon Communications") to help with research into next generation Ethernet.[\[12\]](#cite_note-12)

In early 2016, core router platforms from Cisco, Juniper and other major manufacturers supported 400 Gbit/s full duplex data rates per slot. One, two and four-port 100 GbE and one port 400 GbE [line cards](/wiki/Line_card "Line card") were available. In early 2019, 200 GbE line cards became available after 802.3cd standard ratification.[\[13\]](#cite_note-13)[\[14\]](#cite_note-14) In 2020 the Ethernet Technology Consortium announced a specification for 800 Gigabit Ethernet.[\[15\]](#cite_note-15)

200G Ethernet uses [PAM4](/wiki/PAM4 "PAM4") signaling, which allows 2 bits to be transmitted per clock cycle, but at a higher implementation cost.[\[16\]](#cite_note-16) Cisco introduced an 800G Ethernet switch in 2022.[\[17\]](#cite_note-17) In 2024, Nokia routers with 800G Ethernet were deployed.[\[18\]](#cite_note-18)

## Standards development

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Standards development")\]

The IEEE formed the "IEEE 802.3 Industry Connections Ethernet Bandwidth Assessment Ad Hoc", to investigate the business needs for short and long term bandwidth requirements.[\[19\]](#cite_note-19)[\[20\]](#cite_note-20)[\[21\]](#cite_note-21)

[IEEE 802.3](/wiki/IEEE_802.3 "IEEE 802.3")'s "400 Gb/s Ethernet Study Group" started working on the 400 Gbit/s generation standard in March 2013.[\[22\]](#cite_note-22) Results from the study group were published and approved on March 27, 2014. Subsequently, the IEEE 802.3bs Task Force[\[23\]](#cite_note-23) started working to provide physical layer specifications for several link distances.[\[24\]](#cite_note-obj-24)

The foundational IEEE 802.3bs standard defining lanes, signaling and optical media options was approved on December 6, 2017.[\[4\]](#cite_note-approval-4) The IEEE 802.3cd standard with additional lane and optical media options was approved on December 5, 2018. The IEEE 802.3cn standard for longer (40 km) fiber option was approved on December 20, 2019. The IEEE 802.3cm standard for multimode fiber was approved on January 30, 2020. The IEEE 802.3cu standard for additional single-mode fiber options was approved on February 11, 2021. The IEEE 802.3ck stnadard for copper backplanes and 802.3db standard establishing groundwork for even higher speeds were approved on September 21, 2022.

In November 2022 the IEEE 802.3df project objectives were split in two, with 1.6T and 200G/lane work being moved to the new IEEE 802.3dj project

*   [Original IEEE P802.3df Objectives](https://www.ieee802.org/3/df/proj_doc/objectives_P802d3df_220317.pdf)
*   [Updated IEEE P802.3df Objectives to reduce scope to 800G Ethernet using 100G physical lanes](https://www.ieee802.org/3/df/proj_doc/objectives_P802d3df_221117.pdf)
*   [IEEE P802.3dj Objectives for 1.6 Tbit/s Ethernet and PHYs that employ 200 Gbit/s lanes](https://www.ieee802.org/3/dj/projdoc/objectives_P802d3dj_221117.pdf)
*   [IEEE P802.3dj Objectives updated in May 2023 to include 200G/lane backplane Ethernet](https://www.ieee802.org/3/dj/projdoc/objectives_P802d3dj_230518.pdf)
*   [IEEE P802.3dj Objectives updated in January 2024 to include additional PHY types](https://www.ieee802.org/3/dj/projdoc/objectives_P802d3dj_240125.pdf)

The IEEE 802.3df standard was approved on February 16, 2024.

### IEEE project objectives

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: IEEE project objectives")\]

Like all speeds since [10 Gigabit Ethernet](/wiki/10_Gigabit_Ethernet "10 Gigabit Ethernet"), the standards support only [full-duplex](/wiki/Full-duplex "Full-duplex") operation. Other objectives include:[\[24\]](#cite_note-obj-24)

1.  Preserve the [Ethernet frame](/wiki/Ethernet_frame "Ethernet frame") format utilizing the Ethernet MAC
2.  Preserve minimum and maximum [frame](/wiki/Ethernet_frame "Ethernet frame") size of current Ethernet standard
3.  Support a [bit error ratio](/wiki/Bit_error_ratio "Bit error ratio") (BER) of 10−13, which is an improvement over the 10−12 BER that was specified for 10GbE, 40GbE, and 100GbE.
4.  Support for [OTN](/wiki/Optical_Transport_Network "Optical Transport Network") (transport of Ethernet across optical transport networks), and optional support for [Energy-Efficient Ethernet](/wiki/Energy-Efficient_Ethernet "Energy-Efficient Ethernet") (EEE).

#### 802.3bs project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: 802.3bs project")\]

Define physical layer specifications supporting:[\[24\]](#cite_note-obj-24)

*   400 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   at least 100 m over [multi-mode fiber](/wiki/Multi-mode_fiber "Multi-mode fiber") (400GBASE-SR16) using 16 parallel strands of fiber each at 25 Gbit/s[\[25\]](#cite_note-25)[\[26\]](#cite_note-26)
    *   at least 500 m over [single-mode fiber](/wiki/Single-mode_fiber "Single-mode fiber") (400GBASE-DR4) using 4 parallel strands of fiber each at 100 Gbit/s[\[27\]](#cite_note-trowbridge_3bs_03_0715-27)[\[28\]](#cite_note-28)
    *   at least 2 km over single-mode fiber (400GBASE-FR8) using 8 parallel wavelengths ([CWDM](/wiki/CWDM "CWDM")) each at 50 Gbit/s[\[27\]](#cite_note-trowbridge_3bs_03_0715-27)[\[29\]](#cite_note-29)[\[30\]](#cite_note-ieee802.org-30)
    *   at least 10 km over single-mode fiber (400GBASE-LR8) using 8 parallel wavelengths (CWDM) each at 50 Gbit/s[\[27\]](#cite_note-trowbridge_3bs_03_0715-27)[\[30\]](#cite_note-ieee802.org-30)[\[31\]](#cite_note-31)
    *   8 and 16 lane chip-to-chip/chip-to-module electrical interfaces (400GAUI-8 and 400GAUI-16)
*   200 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   at least 500 m over single-mode fiber (200GBASE-DR4) using 4 parallel strands of fiber each at 50 Gbit/s[\[32\]](#cite_note-32)[\[33\]](#cite_note-httpblog-siemon-comstandardsp941-33)
    *   at least 2 km over single-mode fiber (200GBASE-FR4) using 4 parallel wavelengths (CWDM) each at 50 Gbit/s[\[1\]](#cite_note-NGOATH-1)[\[33\]](#cite_note-httpblog-siemon-comstandardsp941-33)
    *   at least 10 km over single-mode fiber (200GBASE-LR4) using 4 parallel wavelengths (CWDM) each at 50 Gbit/s[\[1\]](#cite_note-NGOATH-1)[\[33\]](#cite_note-httpblog-siemon-comstandardsp941-33)
    *   4 or 8 lane chip-to-chip/chip-to-module electrical interfaces (200GAUI-4 and 200GAUI-8)

#### 802.3cd project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section: 802.3cd project")\]

*   Define four-lane 200 Gbit/s PHYs for operation over:
    *   copper [twin-axial cables](/wiki/Twinaxial_cabling "Twinaxial cabling") with lengths up to at least 3 m (200GBASE-CR4).
    *   printed circuit board backplane with a total channel insertion loss of ≤ 30 dB at 13.28125 GHz (200GBASE-KR4).
*   Define 200 Gbit/s PHYs for operation over [MMF](/wiki/Multi-mode_optical_fiber "Multi-mode optical fiber") with lengths up to at least 100 m (200GBASE-SR4).

#### 802.3ck project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section: 802.3ck project")\]

*   200 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Define a two-lane 200 Gbit/s Attachment Unit interface (AUI) for chip-to-module applications, compatible with PMDs based on 100 Gbit/s per lane optical signaling (200GAUI-2 C2M)
    *   Define a two-lane 200 Gbit/s Attachment Unit Interface (AUI) for chip-to-chip applications (200GAUI-2 C2C)
    *   Define a two-lane 200 Gbit/s PHY for operation over electrical backplanes an insertion loss ≤ 28 dB at 26.56 GHz (200GBASE-KR2)
    *   Define a two-lane 200 Gbit/s PHY for operation over twin axial copper cables with lengths up to at least 2 m (200GBASE-CR2)
*   400 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Define a four-lane 400 Gbit/s Attachment Unit interface (AUI) for chip-to-module applications, compatible with PMDs based on 100 Gbit/s per lane optical signaling (400GAUI-4 C2M)
    *   Define a four-lane 400 Gbit/s Attachment Unit Interface (AUI) for chip-to-chip applications (400GAUI-4 C2C)
    *   Define a four-lane 400 Gbit/s PHY for operation over electrical backplanes an insertion loss ≤ 28 dB at 26.56 GHz (400GBASE-KR4)
    *   Define a four-lane 400 Gbit/s PHY for operation over twin axial copper cables with lengths up to at least 2 m (400GBASE-CR4)

#### 802.3cm project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: 802.3cm project")\]

*   400 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Define a physical layer specification supporting 400 Gbit/s operation over 8 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 100 m (400GBASE-SR8)
    *   Define a physical layer specification supporting 400 Gbit/s operation over 4 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 100 m (400GBASE-SR4.2)

#### 802.3cn project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: 802.3cn project")\]

*   200 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Provide a physical layer specification supporting 200 Gbit/s operation over four wavelengths capable of at least 40 km of SMF (200GBASE-ER4) [\[34\]](#cite_note-8023cn-34)
*   400 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Provide a physical layer specification supporting 400 Gbit/s operation over eight wavelengths capable of at least 40 km of SMF (400GBASE-ER8)[\[34\]](#cite_note-8023cn-34)

#### 802.3cu project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: 802.3cu project")\]

*   Define a four-wavelength 400 Gbit/s PHY for operation over SMF with lengths up to at least 2 km (400GBASE-FR4)
*   Define a four-wavelength 400 Gbit/s PHY for operation over SMF with lengths up to at least 6 km (400GBASE-LR4-6) [\[35\]](#cite_note-8023cu-35)

#### 802.3cw project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=10 "Edit section: 802.3cw project")\]

*   Provide a physical layer specification supporting 400 Gbit/s operation on a single wavelength capable of at least 80 km over a DWDM system (400GBASE-ZR)[\[36\]](#cite_note-8023cw-36) Dual polarization 16-state quadrature amplitude modulation (DP-16QAM) with coherent detection is proposed.[\[37\]](#cite_note-37) The project was canceled in 2024.

#### 802.3db project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=11 "Edit section: 802.3db project")\]

*   200 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Define a physical layer specification that supports 200 Gbit/s operation over 2 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 50 m (200GBASE-VR2)
    *   Define a physical layer specification that supports 200 Gbit/s operation over 2 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 100 m (200GBASE-SR2)
*   400 Gbit/s Ethernet
    *   Define a physical layer specification that supports 400 Gbit/s operation over 4 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 50 m (400GBASE-VR4)
    *   Define a physical layer specification that supports 400 Gbit/s operation over 4 pairs of MMF with lengths up to at least 100 m (400GBASE-SR4)

['IEEE P802.3db 100 Gb/s, 200 Gb/s, and 400 Gb/s Short Reach Fiber Task Force'](https://www.ieee802.org/3/db/P802d3db_Updated_Objectives_Approved_November_2020.pdf)

#### 802.3df project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=12 "Edit section: 802.3df project")\]

*   Adds 800G Ethernet rate and specifies port types using existing 100G per lane technology

[IEEE P802.3df Objectives for 800 Gbit/s Ethernet and 400G and 800G PHYs using 100 Gbit/s lanes](https://www.ieee802.org/3/df/proj_doc/objectives_P802d3df_221117.pdf)

#### 802.3dj project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=13 "Edit section: 802.3dj project")\]

*   Adds 1.6 Tbit/s Ethernet rate and specifies port types using new 200 Gbit/s per lane technology.

[IEEE P802.3dj Objectives for 1.6 Tbit/s Ethernet and 200, 400 800 Gbit/s, and 1.6 Tbit/s PHYs using 200 Gbit/s lanes](https://www.ieee802.org/3/dj/projdoc/objectives_P802d3dj_240314.pdf)

#### 802.3ds project

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=14 "Edit section: 802.3ds project")\]

*   Adds 200, 400, 800 Gbit/s and 1.6 Tbit/s MMF PHYs with 30m and 50m reach.

[IEEE P802.3ds Objectives for 200 Gb/s per Wavelength MMF PHYs](https://www.ieee802.org/3/200GMMF/objectives_200gmmf_01_251113.pdf)

### 400G port types

\[[edit](/w/index.php?title=Terabit_Ethernet&action=edit&section=16 "Edit section: 400G port types")\]

Introduction to English-language Wikipedia

This is a [general introduction](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:INFOPAGES "Wikipedia:INFOPAGES") for visitors to Wikipedia. For aspiring contributors, also see this [guide](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contributing_to_Wikipedia "Wikipedia:Contributing to Wikipedia") and [tutorial](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Introduction "Help:Introduction"). For other uses, see [Wikipedia:Wikipedia (disambiguation)](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikipedia_\(disambiguation\) "Wikipedia:Wikipedia (disambiguation)").

  

Imagine a world in which every single person on the planet is given free access to the sum of all human knowledge. That's what we're doing. — [Jimmy Wales](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales")

  
[Wikipedia](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia "Wikipedia") is a [free online encyclopedia](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Free_encyclopedia "Wikipedia:Free encyclopedia") that anyone can edit, and [millions already have](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikipedians#Number_of_editors "Wikipedia:Wikipedians").

[Wikipedia's purpose](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Purpose "Wikipedia:Purpose") is to present information on all branches of [knowledge](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knowledge "Knowledge"). It consists of [freely editable](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Editing "Help:Editing") content, with articles that contain numerous links guiding readers to more information. Wikipedia is one of many [Wikimedia projects](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation#Projects_and_initiatives "Wikimedia Foundation") hosted by the nonprofit [Wikimedia Foundation](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikimedia_Foundation "Wikipedia:Wikimedia Foundation").

[Wikipedia is written by human](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikipedia_is_written_by_humans,_for_humans "Wikipedia:Wikipedia is written by humans, for humans") volunteers known as [Wikipedians](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_community "Wikipedia community") who [collaborate](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collaborative_writing "Collaborative writing") with [almost no assistance from artificial intelligence](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Editing_policy#Artificial_intelligence_additions "Wikipedia:Editing policy"). Wikipedia articles can be edited by [anyone](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Who_writes_Wikipedia%3F "Wikipedia:Who writes Wikipedia?") with [Internet access](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Internet_access "Internet access"), except in [limited cases](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Protection_policy "Wikipedia:Protection policy") in which editing is restricted to prevent [disruption](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Disruption "Wikipedia:Disruption") or [vandalism](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:VAND "Wikipedia:VAND"). Since its creation on [January 15, 2001](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_Day "Wikipedia Day"), it has grown into the world's [largest](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Size_of_Wikipedia "Wikipedia:Size of Wikipedia") reference [website](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Website "Website"), attracting [over a billion visitors each month](https://stats.wikimedia.org/#/all-wikipedia-projects/reading/unique-devices "stats:"). Wikipedia is a multilingual project, with more than [sixty-seven million articles](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/List_of_Wikipedias#All_Wikipedias_ordered_by_number_of_articles "m:List of Wikipedias") in more than [300 separate wikis](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:SiteMatrix "Special:SiteMatrix") for almost as many languages. This includes 7,178,785 articles in [English](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_language "English language"), with 274,480 active contributors in the past month.

[](/wiki/File:How_does_Wikipedia_work_%E2%80%93_A_WIKI_MINUTE_16-9.webm "Play video")[](/wiki/File:How_does_Wikipedia_work_%E2%80%93_A_WIKI_MINUTE_16-9.webm)

A short video explaining how Wikipedia works

Wikipedia's fundamental principles are summarized in its [five pillars](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Five_pillars "Wikipedia:Five pillars"). While the [Wikipedia community](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_community "Wikipedia community") has developed many [policies and guidelines](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Policies_and_guidelines "Wikipedia:Policies and guidelines"), new editors do not need to be familiar with them before they start contributing.

The quality of content is more important than the expertise of who contributes it. Wikipedia's content must conform with its [policies](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Editing_policy "Wikipedia:Editing policy"), including being [verifiable](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiable "Wikipedia:Verifiable") by published [reliable sources](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Reliable_sources "Wikipedia:Reliable sources"). Contributions based on [personal opinions](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Neutral_point_of_view "Wikipedia:Neutral point of view"), beliefs, or personal experiences, [unreviewed research](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Original_research "Wikipedia:Original research"), libellous material, and [copyright violations](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Copyright_violations "Wikipedia:Copyright violations") are not allowed and will not remain. Wikipedia's software makes it easy to reverse errors, and experienced [editors](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_editor "Wikipedia editor") [watch](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Watchlist "Wikipedia:Watchlist") and [patrol](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Recent_changes_patrol "Wikipedia:Recent changes patrol") bad edits.

[Wikipedia differs from printed references in important ways](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:NOTPAPER "Wikipedia:NOTPAPER"). Anyone can instantly improve it, add quality information, remove misinformation, and fix errors and [vandalism](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Vandalism "Wikipedia:Vandalism"). Since Wikipedia is continually updated, encyclopedic articles on major news events appear within minutes.

For over 25 years, Wikipedians have volunteered their time and talents to create history's most comprehensive encyclopedia while providing references and other resources to researchers worldwide (see [Researching with Wikipedia](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Researching_with_Wikipedia "Wikipedia:Researching with Wikipedia")). In summary, since 2001 Wikipedia has tested the [wisdom of the crowd](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wisdom_of_the_crowd "Wisdom of the crowd") and has found that it succeeds.

To start editing, simply click the Edit or Edit source button, or the pencil icon ![Simple gray pencil icon](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3d/Pencil_edit_icon.svg/40px-Pencil_edit_icon.svg.png), at the top of any [non-protected](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Protection_policy "Wikipedia:Protection policy") Wikipedia page or section.

How to report a problem with an article, or find out more information.

[Article subjects](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contact_us/Article_subjects "Wikipedia:Contact us/Article subjects")  
Problems with articles about you, your company, or somebody you represent.

Find out about the process, how to donate, and information about how your money is spent.

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2a/Contactus-wmcolors.svg/250px-Contactus-wmcolors.svg.png)](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Contactus-wmcolors.svg)

Thank you for your interest in contacting Wikipedia. Before proceeding, some important disclaimers:

1.  **Wikipedia has no central editorial board.** Contributions are made by a large number of volunteers at their own discretion. Edits are neither the responsibility of the [Wikimedia Foundation](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Home "wmf:Home") (the organisation that hosts the site) nor of its staff.
2.  Generally, the agent who responds to an email request will not make edits on your behalf.
3.  Disagreements with content will not be resolved via email. Use the [Edit Request Wizard](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Edit_Request_Wizard "Wikipedia:Edit Request Wizard") to propose specific changes to an article.
4.  Although Wikipedia was co-founded by [Jimmy Wales](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales"), he is not personally responsible for our content.
5.  If you have questions about the *concept* of Wikipedia rather than a specific problem, the [About Wikipedia](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About "Wikipedia:About") page may help.
6.  If you want to ask other users for help with editing or using Wikipedia, stop by the [Teahouse](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Teahouse "Wikipedia:Teahouse"), Wikipedia's [live help channel](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:IRC_help_disclaimer "Wikipedia:IRC help disclaimer"), or the [help desk](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Help_desk "Wikipedia:Help desk") to ask someone for assistance.
7.  If you disagree with an article's content, or are involved in a content dispute, see [Dispute resolution](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Dispute_resolution "Wikipedia:Dispute resolution").

The links on the left should direct you to how to contact us or resolve problems. If you cannot find your issue listed there, you can email helpful, experienced volunteers at .mw-parser-output .monospaced{font-family:monospace,monospace}info-en![@](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/88/At_sign.svg/20px-At_sign.svg.png)wikimedia.org.

You can also use the search box below
